title: Laser Eyes+
description: uhm... just lasers from eyes, like homelander
body:
# Laser Eyes Datapack

A datapack that makes you the **Homelander**, gives the ability to shoot lasers when sneaking (Shift).

## Commands

| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `/tag @s add laserEyes` | Grants you the ability to use lasers. |
| `/tag @s remove laserEyes` | Revokes the laser. |

*Note: Hold the Sneak key (Shift) to fire the laser.*
